# Update file validator

Checks header shape, model 0x1420 and every component's checksum before the first write.

**Category:** function · **Address:** `0x60c964c1` (runtime cached) · <span class="pill pill-planned">Single source</span>
{ .facts }

**Build:** [ep7 firmware 1.1, build 1100](../firmware/ep7-1100.md) · **Cameras:** [Olympus PEN E-P7](../cameras/ep7.md)

It does not read the version field, so same-version and downgrade files are accepted.
